what_differs: Meetings left open whether WagerTech's own tool will hold proofs and send proof URLs or completion status to Salesforce by API. Jira's only open question still frames the decision as GCP sign-off and no ticket covers an inbound proof API.
suggested_action: Add an open-question or decision ticket under WAGR-31 for the WagerTech alternate-solution decision, with owner and date, and note the inbound-API option (sign-up ID + proof URLs to the URL fields) so it can be sized if chosen. Raise it at the next weekly sync.
